tools.duel.description: A one-on-one match made of a few seconds' worth of mini-games back to back. Make a link and send it and you are matched the moment they open it; with no link, "anyone" pairs you with whoever is waiting. The room and what passes through it never touch our server — it goes directly between the two of you.
tools.duel.lead: Few-second mini-games, one on one · one link and you are in · match with anyone · no room on a server
tools.timecapsule.description: A time capsule letter — write one nobody can open before the day you set. No server holds it — the locked letter itself is the address, and the key only comes together from what a public randomness beacon publishes on that day. Not the sender, not the recipient, not this site can open it early, and changing your computer's clock does nothing.
tools.timecapsule.lead: Nobody opens it before the day · no server holding it · changing the clock does not help
tools.chain.description: Runs several tools one after another. Each step’s result becomes the next step’s input, so there is no copying intermediate values by hand.
tools.chain.lead: Each result feeds the next · every step visible · up to 8 steps
